subject.title: improve: skill-workshop prompt banks reactive corrections without a save command

question: Should reactive correction capture live in the always-rendered Skill Workshop prompt, and if so should this PR land as written or be folded into the concurrent prompt-slimming work?
rationale: The PR is technically consistent with the current Skill Workshop boundary, but it adds recurring prompt text while another open maintainer PR is reducing that same prompt surface for token and tone reasons.

options.title: Keep A Compact Trigger
options.body: Land this behavior as a compact system-prompt trigger because the model must decide to call `skill_workshop` before tool-schema action details can help.

options.title: Fold Into Prompt-Slimming PR
options.body: Move the accepted reactive-correction wording into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100481 so one maintainer-owned prompt rewrite controls the final token budget.

options.title: Leave To Autonomous Capture
options.body: Decline the interactive prompt change and rely on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100576 or later harness behavior for reactive correction capture.

recommendation.title: Keep A Compact Trigger
recommendation.body: Land this behavior as a compact system-prompt trigger because the model must decide to call `skill_workshop` before tool-schema action details can help.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the concurrent prompt-slimming PR that determines the prompt-budget direction for this exact section.
